name: sg_contacts_upsert
description: Add or update a marketing contact. Contacts are matched by email address: if the email exists the contact is updated, otherwise a new contact is created. Returns a job_id like the asynchronous SendGrid import. (PUT /v3/marketing/contacts)

email.description: The contact's primary email address. Required and used as the upsert key.

company.description: The name of the contact's employer or account.

phone_number.description: The contact's phone number, including country code.
